author: GameTrailers
description:
IGN is proud to partner once again with ID@Xbox for another exciting showcase on April 23, 2026, that will feature tons of indie games headed to Xbox and PC including: Mistfall Hunter, There Are No Ghosts at the Grand, Aphelion, Solo Leveling Arise Overdrive, and more! Tune in April 23rd at 10AM PT / 1PM ET across all IGN platforms. You wont want to miss it.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox

author: GameTrailers
description:
Enjoy the Blizzard cinematics team's latest work: the opening cinematic for Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred, the imminent second expansion pack for the popular action-RPG. Lord of Hatred will be released on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation platforms on April 28. 

Check out our review of Lord of Hatred if you're interested: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8S6KeieSIWA

#Diablo4LordOfHatred #Gaming #IGN
title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred – Official Opening Cinematic

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the For Honor x Assassin's Creed trailer as the world of Assassin's Creed crosses over into For Honor, bringing the Naoe the Swift Hero Skin for Shinobi, Yasuke the Brave Hero Skin for Shugoki, and Eivor Wolf-Kissed Hero Skin for Beserker on April 23, 2026.
title: For Honor x Assassin's Creed - Official Crossover Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Captured 2 is available now on Steam. Watch the unsettling Captured 2 launch trailer for this anomaly horror game with a survival horror twist. Escape an endless hallway by capturing anomalies on camera and surviving deadly entities.

Emily, a teenage girl who goes missing during a series of unexplained disappearances, finds herself trapped in an endless hallway within her own apartment, slowly losing her memory. Strange anomalies begin to appear, and by capturing them, she catches glimpses of her forgotten past.

#Captured2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Captured 2 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Go Live. Get Famous. Don’t Die. Take a look at the Don't Go Live announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person paranormal horror game in which you play as a streamer doing urbex in abandoned locations to feed your audience's obsession with disturbing content. Every move, every scan, every stream alert draws something closer. And something always answers. Don't Go Live will be available on PC.
title: Don't Go Live - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Bat-Mite Reveal Trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, an upcoming installment in the LEGO Batman franchise developed by TT Games. Players can get a look at the new Bat-Mite suit to bring a comedic flair to the game. Fight crime as Bat-Mite in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, launching on May 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#LEGOBatmanLegacyOfTheDarkKnight #Gaming #IGN
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official Bat-Mite Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Factory 95 is available now on Steam. Watch the Factory 95 launch trailer for this retro Windows-inspired puzzle-automation game about making a slide show factory… in a slide show! Manage your space, make increasingly complex slides and worry about Y2K in this minimalistic factory builder.

#Factory95 #Gaming #IGN
title: Factory 95 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Blood Mall: Retaped is out now on Steam. Watch the Blood Mall: Retaped launch trailer for this short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.
title: Blood Mall: Retaped - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the new trailer for Welcome to Elderfield, the upcoming cozy pixel-art horror game that brings a bit of creepiness to its chill farming. A playable demo is now available on Steam on April 23 if you'd like to check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195440/Welcome_to_Elderfield/
title: Welcome to Elderfield - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Rules of Spycraft Trailer for 007 First Light, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game centered on the early years of James Bond, developed by IO Interactive. Get the rundown on all the tactics and strategies to deploy while on the field as the legendary 007. Blend in, prepare for the mission, and always be ready to improvise when the mission takes an unexpected turn. 007 First Light is launching on May 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a release on Nintendo Switch 2 later in Summer 2026.
title: 007 First Light - Official Rules of Spycraft Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Revenant Survivors, an action survival horde roguelite game developed by Mongma Studio. Players will make use of devastating combos against waves of enemies. Collect their souls, attain new skills, and become evil itself. Revenant Survivors is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Revenant Survivors - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest Star Trucker trailer for the interstellar trucking simulator game to see what to expect with the Business Ventures update, which introduces new job-based progression, allowing players to take on unique roles across the galaxy as the ultimate “Galactic Handyman.” From cleaning up graffiti to helping refuel intergalactic drones, players can win exciting rewards such as interior customizations and valuable ingots while making the galaxy a better place. Additionally, you can now customize the interior of your cab with a range of options for color palettes, dashboard accessories, wall panels and more. The Business Ventures update for Star Trucker is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC via Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and GOG.
title: Star Trucker - Official Business Ventures Update #1: Galactic Handyman Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the release date trailer for The Shore: Enhanced Edition, and get a look at this a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure that blends exploration and puzzles in a world shaped by ancient gods and forbidden knowledge. In The Shore: Enhanced Edition, you play as Andrew, a father searching for his missing daughter on a remote island abandoned by humanity. As you explore its decaying ruins and twisted landscapes, reality begins to fracture. The island hides secrets older than time and every step forward pulls you deeper into a nightmare shaped by fear, loss and obsession.

The Shore: Enhanced Edition will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) on April 30, 2026.

#TheShoreEngancedEdition #Gaming #IGN
title: The Shore: Enhanced Edition - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the new trailer for The Player Who Can't Level Up, the upcoming anime-styled fast-action-roguelite based on the comic and webtoon, and then try the demo for yourself on Steam on April 23: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985520/The_Player_Who_Cant_Level_Up/
title: The Player Who Can't Level Up: Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Kick, a 2D anime side-scrolling platformer developed by Nospacelost. Players will explore a vibrant, stylized world by way of kicking a soccer (football) through a variety of levels. Master the art of controlling the physics-based ball, complete challenges, and unlock skins in the process. Kick is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Kick - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Rogue Voltage, a card-battling automation, deckbuilding game developed by Horizont Computergrafik. Players will wire circuits to construct powerful machines to clear monsters from the board. Rogue Voltage is launching into Version 1.0 on May 1 for PC (Steam).
title: Rogue Voltage - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Console Demo Launch Trailer for Bubsy 4D, an action exploration 3D platformer developed by Fabraz. Players will take on new challenges as Bubsy the bobcat in an all-new adventure. Traverse alien planets, collect yarn, and battle enemies on a grand excursion. The demo for Bubsy 4D is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam), with the game launching on May 22.
title: Bubsy 4D - Official Console Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 'Qinchuan' Hexi Expansion Finale Announcement Trailer for Where Winds Meet, the third-person free-to-play action online open-world RPG developed by Everstone Studio. Players can get a taste of what's in store with the last addition to the Hexi Expansion, which sees the introduction of Qinchuan. The 'Qinchuan' Hexi Expansion Finale for Where Winds Meet launches on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Windows).
title: Where Winds Meet - Official 'Qinchuan' Hexi Expansion Finale Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the latest trailer for Owlcat Games ambitious sci-fi action RPG: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn. Game Design Director Leonid Rastorguev, and Lead Game Designer Grigory Ponomarev take you through the mechanics and content of the Beta test which begins on April 22nd! 

The Expanse: Osiris Reborn launches in 2027 for PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GoG), PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S!
title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn - Official Beta Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Lara Croft Legendary Appearance Trailer for Delta Force, the hit first-person free-to-play action multiplayer shooter developed by Team Jade. Players can embody the iconic Tomb Raider as Lara Croft through a Luna legendary collaboration appearance alongside her signature bow to gain the edge in any combat engagement. Fight as Lara Croft on April 30 in Delta Force for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Delta Force - Official Lara Croft Legendary Appearance Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into Wolfgang Krauser's moves in this latest Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves trailer for the fighting game. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Wolfgang Krauser arrives on April 24, 2026.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Wolfgang Krauser Character Breakdown Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Official Trailer for Tides of Tomorrow, a first-person multiplayer narrative adventure game developed by Digixart. Players will explore a dying world full of vibrant characters in need of saving from devastating pollution. Take to the seas and experience the choices of other players throughout the game that affect your playthrough directly. Save the planet of Tides of Tomorrow, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Tides of Tomorrow - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the April 1.69 Update Trailer for Gran Turismo 7, the latest addition to the racing simulation franchise developed by Polyphony Digital. Players can get behind the wheel of the 1993 Porsche 911 Turbo S Leichtbau, 1993 Renault Twingo, and the 2024 Yangwang U9 in the latest update to Gran Turismo 7. Update 1.69 is launching on April 22 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).
title: Gran Turismo 7 - Official April 1.69 Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Gallipoli, a WW1 first-person action shooter developed by BlackMill Games. Players will become entrenched in the authenticity of legendary instances throughout World War 1. Fight across critical points on the Ottoman Fronts with a variety of weapons, time-accurate uniforms, and an array of environments from deserts, urban lands, or coastal dunes. Gallipoli is launching on May 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Microsoft Store).
title: Gallipoli - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Developer MoonPyre Studio introduces you to Hellforged, a new loot-focused bullet-hell extraction game that has you fighting off massive waves of demons. It's in development for PC and due out in Q4 2026. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4554250/Hellforged/
title: Hellforged: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look a the launch trailer for Caromble!, a 3D physics-based brick breaker adventure developed by Crimson Owl Studios. Caromble! blends brick breaking with pinball, platforming, and trick-shot puzzles. Guide the ball through a dynamic world, battle challenging bosses, and unlock game-changing powerups. Save the ball. Save the world. Caromble! is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Caromble! - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Reshine, a cozy restoration game developed by Quite OK Games. Players will take apart, clean, repaint, and restore old objects to their former glory. Make use of a variety of tools and customize the items with a plethora of paints and materials. Reshine is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#Reshine #Gaming #IGN
title: Reshine - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Fear Tall Grass is a dark fantasy autobattler roguelike creature collector set in a world consumed by Vilekin, evil creatures that are destroying civilization. As Gray, the last steward of the Oathguard, you must brave the tall grass to learn to tame these creatures and protect what remains of humanity. Watch the Fear Tall Grass announcement trailer for a peek at gameplay, creatures you'll fight and tame, and more. Fear Tall Grass will be available on PC, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch.

#FearTallGrass #Gaming #IGN
title: Fear Tall Grass - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Cherry Blossom Event Teaser Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players can now explore decorated spaces with the Cherry Blossom Event, packed with powerful ronin bosses to take on. Earn the Rising Sun mask in the Cherry Blossom Event in The Division 2, available now through May 12 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Ubisoft Connect, Steam, and Epic Games Store).
title: The Division 2 - Official Cherry Blossom Event Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Season Echo Cinematic Trailer for Delta Force, a free-to-play action first-person shooter developed by Team Jade. Players can get the rundown on the latest season of Delta Force, showcasing some of the new elements being added to the game with a cinematic flair. Season Echo of Delta Force is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Delta Force - Official Season Echo Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Console Launch Trailer for Drop Duchy: Complete Edition, a puzzle strategy roguelike game developed by Sleepy Mill Studio. Players will engage with the block mechanics to recruit troops, find resources, and attain victory. Drop Duchy: Complete Edition is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Investigation: The Carter Tapes, a first-person action horror puzzle game developed by ShockyyDoc Games. Players will embody a troubled detective on a horrid case that finds himself trapped between life and death. Explore a subway buckling over time and escape in Investigation: The Carter Tapes, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Investigation: The Carter Tapes - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Clockwork Ambrosia, a 2D Metroidvania action platformer developed by Realmsoft. Players will explore a steampunk island called Aspida with Iris on a daring quest to solve the island's mysteries and achieve freedom. Make use of a suite of different weapons, engage with an in-depth crafting system, and unlock new powers. Clockwork Ambrosia is launching on May 12 for PC (Steam).
title: Clockwork Ambrosia - Official Release Date Trailer
